statement: Two findings from one pair of server starts. (1) The Qwen MTP head lives entirely in qwen3.8-flash-next-q4-mtp.gguf and there is no auto-discovery of it: without --mtp-model the engine reports MTP=off while accepting --mtp-draft 7 --mtp-timing silently. docs/m5max-runbook.md recorded the MTP arm without --mtp-model until 2026-09-07. (2) With the sidecar loaded and the head ready, ds4 enters the speculative path on requests WITHOUT a tool schema and not once on requests WITH one.

provenance.no_autodiscovery: ds4.c:67798 at ds4-metal ba01f5d gates the sidecar load on opt->mtp_path; mtp_ready is set nowhere else on the Qwen path
provenance.split_meaning: the byte at which run.py's draft probe began recording, from its own log line; before = pre-batch prompts, after = the six agent trials

claims.statement: Without --mtp-model the graph line reports MTP=off verifier=off; with it, MTP=Q4_K/Q8_0/BF16 verifier=block/max16.

claims.statement: Speculative cycles appear only on requests without a tool schema. Perfect separation, not a gradient.
Silence after the split is not switched-off counters: the server's argv carries --mtp-timing (run.counters_on('ds4') is True) and the same process wrote 340 cycles before it.
